collection.title: Alfa Romeo Giulietta 2010 to 2020 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: An Alfa Romeo Giulietta 2010 - 2020 model requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 18" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
